draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41ms for Brisling and T1.r2.lat=118ms for Talmar, both measured on Corvex A2. The claim uses "may" and reports the exact median latencies, appropriately scoped to the Brindle-Voice test set. No statistical test was reported, but the claim does not assert significance.
